title: ornithogalum orthophyllum subsp. psammophilum
intro: Ornithogalum orthophyllum subsp. psammophilum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Asparagaceae family, is a species of ornithogalum found in South Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ornithogalum orthophyllum subsp. psammophilum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating wounds, reducing fever, and relieving muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
